field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Blends keyword search with meaning-based (vector) search using OpenAI embeddings, configured under LLM AI. Turn on only after the "AI Search Vector" indexer (Index Management) has completed at least one full reindex - until then the vector index does not exist and every request silently falls back to keyword-only.

field.label: Keyword Score Weight
field.comment: 0-1. Each score is normalized to [0,1] independently before blending, so the two weights are not required to sum to 1. Default 0.4.

group.label: Vector Index Content
group.comment: What each product's vector is built from, besides its name and descriptions. Changes here take effect only after a full reindex of the "AI Search Vector" indexer.

field.label: Include Category Paths
field.comment: Adds the product's category breadcrumbs (e.g. "Parent > Child"), in the store view's language. Inactive categories are left out.

field.label: Include Attributes
field.comment: Adds attribute values as "Label: value" lines, using store view labels. Automatic takes the attributes marked Use in Search or Use in Layered Navigation that have dropdown, multiple-select or text values; Yes/No attributes are left out unless selected explicitly. Exact requirements from a query are still enforced by search filters - the vector only adds meaning, it does not filter.

field.label: Attributes
field.comment: Descriptive attributes work best - what a product is made of, what it is for, what it looks like. Identifiers, codes and numbers add noise and make results worse. A Yes/No attribute is written as its label, only for products where it is Yes.
